patch_description: Makes door opening an explicit action-dependent state transition. Movement legality, enemy kernels, survival conditioning, and timed route memoization carry the opening history. The learner retains the preceding door state and accepts explained opening transitions; exported forecasts reflect the selected action. Existing anonymous movement-law learning and separate learning/planning interventions are preserved. These changes target inconsistent door forecasts and unsafe continuations; performance gains remain to be measured.
